messages:
maris: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need clear owners and handoffs for the cache/regional outage actions. I spun up jira tickets, please claim and add ACs.

juan: Paste the ticket ids + quick acceptance criteria pls.

maris: Tickets created: 
- RINF-4940: eviction-policy tuning + TTL defaults. owner: UNASSIGNED. due: 2026-04-05. acceptance: staging replay shows <20% eviction spikes for 48h.
- RINF-4941: region failover playbook and test drill. owner: UNASSIGNED. due: 2026-04-08. acceptance: documented steps + successful staging failover drill.
- RINF-4942: nightly regression harness (bench + alert). owner: UNASSIGNED. due: 2026-04-15. acceptance: nightly job, alert on >5% perf regression vs baseline.

maris: RACI draft: Responsible = Juan/Olivia; Accountable = Maris; Consulted = ops-sre; Informed = product/support. Flag issues.

olivia: I can own RINF-4940. Plan: config matrix, perf replay, PR by 3/22, staging deploy 3/25. Will add test vectors.

juan: I'll take RINF-4941 (failover playbook) and coordinate the drill. ETA: draft 3/28, staging drill 4/03.

ops-bot: Postmortem doc uploaded: https://docs.internal.redwood.com/postmortems/2026-03-cache-regional-outage

maris: Please add the label "postmortem-action" and "recurring-incident" if you think this is repeated. We saw similar Tue morning spikes thrice.

olivia: Adding recurring-incident to RINF-4940 and linking previous incidents. Also adding acceptance test: synthetic burst replay P95 < 250ms.

juan: Handoff plan: implement -> staging validation (ops-sre) -> canary -> post-rollout verification (Maris). Document checklists in tickets.

maris: I'll act as PI-level owner to track closure. I'll run weekly triage and post a short status in #postmortems every Friday.

olivia: Claimed RINF-4940 and set status to In Progress. Added eviction graphs and test cases.

juan: Claimed RINF-4941 and scheduled staging drill invite.

maris: Last process note: when closing, attach staging+canary logs and perf deltas. If acceptance criteria not met, re-open and tag eng-sre. :thumbsup:
